The '''gardener droid''', '''gardening droid''', or '''landscaping droid''' was a classification of [[Class five droid/Legends|class five droid]] used to trim gardens, prune hedges, and to perform other tasks to improve the appearance of an area of land. Different models were fitted with a variety of tools, such as shears or watering implements. They differed from the [[Class two droid/Legends|class two]] [[environmental droid]] classification, which were advanced models designed for terraforming.

Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Mark II Z3-NO landscaping droid|Mark II Z3-NO]] line landscaping droid was popular among the rich citizens of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Gardener droids were used aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Star of Empire]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], a gardener droid found [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tresina Lobi]]'s body in the hedges of [[Fellowship Plaza]], after she was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Lumiya]] and [[Alema Rar]] in a [[Duel in the Fellowship Plaza]].
